verdict.rationale: Snyk explicitly ships 'Snyk Container' for scanning container images and is described platform-wide as scanning 'container images' alongside code and dependencies, and one community comment even notes hearing good things about the container security tooling specifically. missing for 10: explicit doc language distinguishing OS-package vs application-layer vulnerability detection within images, and any hands-on/independent verification of a container scan (the probes only exercise `snyk test`/MCP, not `snyk container test`).
